g.text: E016 · full draft with backbone graph
Measured progress: HTTP and isolated modules stay separate
Independent processes/pairs are shown individually. These are different baselines and workloads; speedups must not be added or multiplied.
Top: 24 fresh HTTP processes; 19 input → 32 output tokens, target only, C1/8/32/64. Each pair ratio uses that pair's process summary.
Bottom left: 3 fresh processes × 3 prompts × 3 blocks, all 27 points; each process GM uses its 9 cases. Bottom right: 1 process, all 9 prompt/block cases.
Module ratios use full-draft median latencies. Observation spread is not a confidence interval. E016 GM = 1.040×, below the 1.10× screen gate.
